[[File:Lizardmen icon.png|left]]
'''Lizardmen brute''' are reptilian humanoids that inhabit the [[Lizardman Canyon]], the [[Lizardman Settlement]] and the [[Battlefront]].

Although brutes in the Battlefront wield a sword and shield, they have the same stats as regular brutes.
